finalCompletionDefinition: AlembicPlugin marketplace distribution is converted to a small plugin shell plus pinned npm runtime bootstrap, with clean first-run install, cached restart, no forbidden embedded runtime artifacts, representative MCP behavior, and controller-reviewed raw validation evidence.

demands.title: MPB0 Market Evidence And Current Artifact Audit
demands.purpose: Confirm official Codex plugin marketplace constraints, local Lark Remote market evidence, OpenAI curated plugin examples, and current Alembic artifact risks before product implementation.
completionEvidence: current Alembic artifact size and forbidden-content scan

demands.title: MPB1 Runtime Package Boundary
demands.purpose: Define and build the pinned npm Alembic runtime package boundary without local file dependencies.

demands.title: MPB2 Lightweight Plugin Shell And Bootstrap Script
demands.purpose: Replace runtime.tgz/embedded runtime startup with .mcp.json -> node ./bin/alembic-codex-start.mjs and clean shell artifact packaging.

demands.title: MPB3 First-Run Install, Cache, Upgrade, And Failure Semantics
demands.purpose: Implement runtime cache selection, exact-version install, cached reuse, version mismatch upgrade, lock/concurrency handling, and diagnostics.

demands.title: MPB4 Clean Marketplace Simulation And MCP Smoke
demands.purpose: Prove clean Codex plugin cache install, MCP launch, tools/list, representative callTool behavior, and restart behavior from a fresh market-like artifact.

demands.title: MPB5 Release Acceptance And Archive
demands.purpose: Review raw evidence, enforce final market artifact gates, accept or rework the package, and archive the final packaging contract.
